yt.description:
The deposit didn't come. No letter, no call. It's usually one of four things, and only one is about money.

1) A return wasn't filed: yours or your spouse's. No return, no benefit.
2) Your income went up: every July the CRA recalculates from last year's return, so a raise shows up a year later.
3) Your marital status changed: e.g. married in March 2026 → tell the CRA by the end of April. Your new spouse's income is added, and the CCB is adjusted starting the month after the change.
4) A child turned 18: that child's CCB stops.

The twist: only one of the four is about how much you earn.

Check your messages in CRA My Account before you call.
